radius_diagnostics.analysis_kind: acceptance-oriented diagnostic radii, not approved acceptance criteria

procedure.matching: Same class; predictions ordered by descending confidence, original-index tie break; highest-IoU unmatched gold at IoU >= 0.5, gold-row tie break; preserve endpoint correspondence.
procedure.matching_verification: Recomputed all 60 image/threshold scores and required exact equality of saved matches, unmatched indices, endpoint errors, counts and coverage inputs; analysis code files match original inference code hashes.
procedure.endpoint_error: Euclidean original-pixel distance; success includes equality at the stated radius.
procedure.returned_endpoint: Matched object, gold visibility 2, prediction endpoint confidence >= 0.5, finite coordinates, 0 <= x < width and 0 <= y < height.
procedure.endpoint_denominator: All 1227 gold-visible endpoints; unmatched objects, low-confidence/nonfinite/out-of-frame predicted points fail.
procedure.both_point_object_denominator: Every reference object whose two gold endpoints have visibility 2, including unmatched objects. Both corresponding endpoints must return and each be within the radius.
procedure.object_precision: TP/(TP+FP) at the fixed box matching rule, distinct from box confidence.
procedure.object_recall: TP/(TP+FN) at the fixed box matching rule.
procedure.zero_denominator: null; empty images still contribute any false positives to detection totals.
procedure.worst_image_ranking: Lowest 5px success fraction first, then more failures, then image ID; zero-denominator images excluded from that ranking.
procedure.immutability: No source, image, label, model, or saved inference output was modified.

unlocatable_reference_availability.population: Reference endpoints with visibility 0 on objects assigned a prediction by the unchanged fixed matching rule.
unlocatable_reference_availability.denominator: All reference-v0 endpoints on matched objects; reference-v0 endpoints on unmatched objects are reported separately and excluded.
unlocatable_reference_availability.returned_on_unlocatable_reference: Corresponding predicted endpoint has confidence >= 0.5, finite coordinates and 0 <= x < width, 0 <= y < height.
unlocatable_reference_availability.meaning: Availability/disagreement diagnostic, not an assertion of a physical false positive. v=0 means the reference cannot supply a reliable coordinate.
unlocatable_reference_availability.top_image_order: More eligible outputs first, then higher eligible fraction, then image ID; examples show up to three highest endpoint confidences per listed image.

limits: Pixel radii 2, 5 and 10 are illustrative diagnostics, not supervisor-approved tolerance or proof of physical placement accuracy.
These are the development-validation images used for checkpoint selection, not an independent test.

Points and objects within an image, and potentially related capture frames, are correlated. Do not treat 1227 points or all objects as independent scene trials; no independence-based confidence interval is claimed.

Success remains conditional on the fixed object-matching protocol, but its denominator includes all eligible gold endpoints/objects. A close corner on a sub-IoU box still fails this end-to-end diagnostic.
These diagnostics compare predictions to the frozen annotations; they do not establish which side is correct in an annotation/model disagreement.

returned_on_unlocatable_reference measures eligible outputs against reference unlocatability. It does not prove physical visibility/occlusion, hallucination or a wrong location; no coordinate error is computed for v0 points.

unmatched_review_examples.review_note: Reference right corner is unlocatable, while an unused nearby proposal gives a high-confidence coordinate. The reference object is unmatched at IoU 0.5, so this is a separate review example, not a counted matched-object availability event. No hidden gold coordinate is inferred.

endpoint_cutoff_diagnostics.analysis: Separate endpoint-cutoff replay illustration; no accepted cutoff or deployment pass/fail
limits: Same 20 development images; 5px is illustrative, not an accepted tolerance.
Object matching and its v0 denominator stay fixed across cutoffs.
Returned-on-unlocatable-reference is an availability disagreement, not a geometric error for hidden points.

training_label_text_audit.scope: All 137 committed training label TXT files; no training image bytes opened or downloaded; no labels modified; no inference or training.

source.identity_set_encoding: UTF-8 JSON sorted by image id, keys sorted, separators comma/colon; items contain id, label, label_sha256
source.dimensions_source: manifest.records[*].original_size, interpreted as [width, height]; all training records declare 1280x720

exact_duplicate_rows.definition: All 11 parsed numeric values equal within the same image; differing whitespace/decimal spelling does not make distinct annotations.

geometric_review_flags.status: Review flags only; these do not establish visual annotation errors and are not automatic rejection/correction rules.

visible_endpoint_outside_bbox_gt_2px.definition: Euclidean distance from a v=2 endpoint to the nearest point of its own closed bbox exceeds 2 original-image pixels; dx and dy are recorded separately.

bbox_outside_image.definition: Any decoded box edge outside the geometric image rectangle [0,width] x [0,height]. Strict positive overrun; tiny decimal-rounding overruns are counted separately.

interpretation: Hash and parser success establishes consistency with the frozen reference and declared text schema, not visual correctness.
No image inspection was performed for this training-label audit. Any geometric flag needs the original image and an agreed box/visibility convention before changing a label.
No automated correction, training-data promotion, or model tuning is justified solely by this report.

queued_visual_review.reviewer: Coordinated independent assistant visual reviews; not supervisor sign-off
queued_visual_review.method: Original images and enlarged raw crops inspected before comparing gold and model overlays where possible; predictions inspected afterward. No hidden corner was inferred, and no reference label was changed.
queued_visual_review.confidence_scale: Qualitative confidence in visual adjudication, separate from saved model probability.
queued_visual_review.policy_finding: Reviewed instructions specify actual front-lower corners and missing visibility, but do not define an explicit tight visible-front versus amodal full-front bounding-box rule or an object-inclusion threshold when both endpoints are unlocatable.
queued_visual_review.overall_status: All12 queued validation rows reviewed by assistants, with unresolved box-extent/inclusion decisions. No unambiguous endpoint-label correction accepted. Not supervisor sign-off.
queued_visual_review.remaining_blind_spot: Baseline visible-gold endpoint metrics exclude reference-v0 points. Separate matched-object availability diagnostics now record outputs on reference-unlocatable sides; physical judgments remain limited to the inspected examples.
queued_visual_review.recommended_next_decision: Confirm one box-extent and occlusion/object-inclusion convention with the supervisor, then adjudicate corresponding examples consistently. Keep hidden endpoints missing and do not change validation reference to fit predictions.

reviews.model_assessment: Do not treat prediction 60 as an accepted correspondence to reference row 8, and do not replace the sliver with its box or endpoints. Its 18.38 px right-endpoint diagnostic difference is not reliable same-object evidence.
reviews.required_decision: Confirm the inclusion and visibility rule for one-pixel-border slivers; leave the frozen reference unchanged meanwhile.

reviews.required_decision: Adjudicate visible-front versus amodal box extent. Separately record false returned points on gold-missing endpoints as an occlusion failure mode.

reviews.required_decision: Use the same occlusion/extent policy as row 52; keep the hidden endpoint missing.

visibility_conclusion.right: No reliable actual lower-right corner is exposed; retain canonical 0 0 0.

reviews.evidence: Only the rightmost patch of the face is visible. The 80 px reference box extends far left behind the gripper, unlike the narrow visible-strip boxes used for rows 52 and 53. This is evidence that an occlusion extent convention needs adjudication.

saved_prediction_diagnostic.note: No positive-overlap unused prediction in the saved review queue; not a declaration that no relevant model output exists anywhere.

visibility_conclusion.right: The actual lower-right corner is exposed near (558.34,198.68); retain v=2.

reviews.evidence: The visible white face extends substantially above the reference box top y=185.72. The gold rectangle is only 15.44 px high and covers a lower strip of this unobscured face. additional_largest_endpoint_error_review.reviewer: assistant independent visual inspection; not supervisor sign-off
additional_largest_endpoint_error_review.classification: model_right_point_above_actual_lower_corner; minor rounded-corner ambiguity does not explain displacement
additional_largest_endpoint_error_review.visual_confidence: high for the direction/type of model error; lower for subpixel placement within the blurred rounded corner
additional_largest_endpoint_error_review.method: Viewed the original full frame, then two raw nearest-neighbor crops before inspecting prediction coordinates or any overlay. Then compared a point-only overlay: gold blue, prediction magenta. No new inference or reference editing.
observations: Reference row 10 is the left-column face immediately above the lower partly covered face. Its center is partly obscured by the gripper, but the right lower corner is exposed.
The visible white front terminates at a lower boundary near the current gold point (709,454). The gold point is not an obvious upper-lip or neighboring-object annotation.

The predicted right point (705.691,439.522) is about 14.478 pixels above and 3.309 pixels left of gold, on the right-side/face region above the lower boundary. It does not follow the actual lower corner.

The corner is rounded and blurred, so exact pixel placement has some ambiguity. The lower edge remains visibly below the prediction; this ambiguity is insufficient to explain the full 14.851-pixel reference error.
additional_largest_endpoint_error_review.visibility_conclusion: The right actual lower corner is visible; retain v=2 and the existing reference coordinate. Do not relocate gold to the prediction.
additional_largest_endpoint_error_review.interpretation: This is evidence of a genuine endpoint-localization failure within an accepted object match, with endpoint confidence about 0.934. It supplies a concrete model-error example after label inspection; it does not by itself justify broad relabeling, a new architecture, or broad fine-tuning.
